entities.summary: Angkhan Chomphuphuang, known professionally as Pajonsuk, is a Thai former professional Muay Thai fighter and amateur boxer. He is a former Lumpinee Stadium Welterweight Champion who also competed in Wushu and as an amateur boxer including in the 2008 Olympics.
